correctness.rationale: The marked-cycle bijection gives the exact size-biased law. Taking f(k)=k yields the covariance after subtracting the exact Ewens mean total-cycle count. The sign bracket is strictly decreasing in r, has opposite signs at r=1 and r=n for n>=2, and its Riemann-sum limit has a unique zero at 1-exp(-1/theta). The gamma-ratio asymptotic gives the displayed macroscopic covariance profile.

value.rationale: Total richness and the frequency spectrum are canonical observables of Ewens samples. The result identifies a sharp dependence phase: counts of small frequency classes covary positively with richness, while sufficiently macroscopic classes covary negatively, with a closed threshold fraction and an explicit limiting profile. The finite Palm identity also gives a reusable mixed-moment relation beyond the covariance itself.
